title: Mixpanel MXP 2026 User Conference in San Francisco – May 12 Free Event with Keynotes and Workshops
summary: Hey everyone! Mixpanel's annual user conference is back in San Francisco and it's right around the corner! 📍 MXP 2026 | May 12 | Terra Gallery, SF | Free to attend 🎟️ A full day of sessions for product and data practitioners—hands-on workshops, real talks from teams at Chewy, Sprout Social, Asana, Snowflake, and more, plus a happy hour to close it out. A few things on the agenda worth calling out 🤩 : • Mixpanel Masters: Live sandbox workshops on Experiments and AI • Snowflake keynote on scaling AI programs • Ecommerce panel with Mejuri and others on product strategy I'm most excited for our opening lineup: a company vision from CEO, Jen Taylor (https://www.linkedin.com/in/talkwjt/), a product vision from our CTO, Anant Gupta (https://www.linkedin.com/in/anantgupta1/), and a fireside chat between CRO, Damian Gona (https://www.linkedin.com/in/damian-gona-466ab121/) and Kinjal Shah, Head of Analytics, Experimentation and AI at Chewy (https://www.linkedin.com/in/kinjalkumarshah/). What a way to start the day! 🚀 ↪️ Save your seat (https://mixpanel.com/mxp/san-francisco-2026?utm_source=mixpanel-community&utm_medium=slack&utm_campaign=MXPSF-OpeningSessions&utm_content=)
